Empirical full-duration references are estimates. Lower pseudo-error, greater apparent stability or stronger area significance does not alone establish more accurate biological timescales or a justified primary improvement criterion.
Signed Equation 21 versus absolute-error computation requires figure-specific formula/mask reconciliation. Do not minimize signed bias as accuracy or generalize one summary component to all source panels.
Original simulation realizations, baseline curves and source-comparable improvement criteria remain unresolved. New simulations or window draws are extensions.
The later synthetic inventory explicitly states metadata_only:true and scope_change:false. No explicit scientific instruction approving empirical-primary replacement was identified in the bounded gate and earlier curation log; component acceptance and a broad reproduction inventory are not such authority.
Full-panel reproduction tolerances, native independent verification and empirical superiority remain unavailable. Useful partial or secondary evidence must not grant full-primary success through a schema workaround.

Preserve original area versus unit fitting recipes and panel-specific eligible sets. No every-figure requirement is inferred.
